physicalNotes: Radius 0.3714 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract): 258,383 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.3527 +/- 0.0081 solar masses from Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3376 +/- 45 K from Meier Valdés et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1468 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...698A..68M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
